annotations.annotation_text: Page 87 opens Book 1, Chapter 4 ("The Burial of HCE") during the Age of Gods (transition) phase. This passage continues the burial of the giant in the landscape, the archaeological mound, the Four Annalists surveying history, featuring HCE, Mamalujo, Kate the Slop. The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.
